SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_assessment WHERE risk_level >= 3 AND assessment_status = 1

SELECT ra.id, ra.project_id as projectId, ra.assessment_name as projectName, ra.risk_level as riskLevel, ra.total_score as totalScore, ra.assessment_date as assessmentDate, ra.assessment_status as assessmentStatus, CASE WHEN ra.risk_level = 4 THEN '极高风险' WHEN ra.risk_level = 3 THEN '高风险' WHEN ra.risk_level = 2 THEN '中风险' WHEN ra.risk_level = 1 THEN '低风险' ELSE '未知' END as riskLevelName FROM risk_assessment ra WHERE ra.risk_level >= 3 ORDER BY ra.risk_level DESC, ra.total_score DESC, ra.create_time DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT TO_CHAR(assessment_date, 'YYYY-MM') as month, COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level >= 3 THEN 1 END) as highRiskCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 4 THEN 1 END) as extremeRiskCount, AVG(total_score) as avgScore FROM risk_assessment WHERE assessment_date >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -#{months}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(assessment_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month DESC

SELECT ra.project_id as projectId, '项目' || ra.project_id as projectName, 1 as projectStatus, SYSDATE as createTime, NVL(TO_CHAR(ra.last_assessment_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '从未评估') as lastAssessmentDate, CASE WHEN ra.last_assessment_date IS NULL THEN '需要首次评估' WHEN (SYSDATE - ra.last_assessment_date) > 90 THEN '需要重新评估' ELSE '评估正常' END as assessmentStatus FROM ( SELECT project_id, MAX(assessment_date) as last_assessment_date FROM risk_assessment GROUP BY project_id ) ra WHERE ra.last_assessment_date IS NULL OR (SYSDATE - ra.last_assessment_date) > 90 ORDER BY ra.last_assessment_date ASC
